title: 第13章 震惊第14章 雪中送炭一级资助
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
所谓资助会，其实属于一个宗门里的私下组织。
与归元派无关。
杜天带着张宿，一路来到了一座宽敞的院子。
“咚咚咚”。
杜天上前敲门。
院门打开，一名外门弟子看到是杜天后，脸上一喜。
“杜兄，张师兄可是选好了哪一份资助？”
杜天摇了摇头说道：“你们给的这些资助，张师兄都不满意，因此，张师兄亲自来到资助会，和你们商谈。”
随即，杜天侧身让开，露出了身后的张宿。
“张师兄？”
那名外门弟子立刻就反应了过来。
这位可是最近外门名声大噪的张宿！
“张师兄，大驾光临，资助会上下顿时蓬荜生辉，请进！”
这位外门弟子对张宿态度极为恭敬。
张宿则直接走进了院子里。
这间院子也是资助会临时租住，里面还有许多人，基本上都是外门弟子。
归元派有规定，不是外门弟子，不得住在外门。
这些外门弟子，并不是被资助的天才，而仅仅是每个月用银子雇佣而来，维持资助会的运转罢了。
张宿走进了客厅里。
“张师兄稍等，资助会副会长马上就到。”

张宿点了点头。
随后，杜天在张宿耳边轻声说道：“资助会副会长叫做严波，也是气血境九层的外门弟子。”
没过多久，严波到了。
对方一袭白衫，倒是气度不凡。
“张师弟。”
“严师兄。”
两人坐下。
严波开口问道：“张师弟多半已经收到了许多份资助了吧？是对哪里不满意，还是怎么回事？若有需求，请尽管提。”
“需求……”
张宿望着严波，平静地说道：“张某的确有需求，你们对张某的资助太低，只是区区四级资助。”
严波瞬间了然。
他大概也猜到了。
严波笑着说道：“张师弟，资助等级，是由那些资助者评定。师弟或许天资很高，但目前超龄了，宗门内，超龄弟子想要晋升内门，太难了。”
“或许，这就是那些资助者的顾虑。”
“超龄……这是一个问题。不过，也许那些资助者，并不知道张某真正的天赋！”
严波微微一怔。
他上下仔细打量张宿，发现他一副自信满满模样。
难道，张宿还有什么底气？
这时，张宿调动体内的气血。
“轰”。

顿时，一股雄浑的气血威压透体而出，瞬间笼罩住了严波。
“这是……打破了人体极限？”
严波也是气血境九层。
content_en:
The so-called funding association actually belongs to a private organization within the sect.
It has nothing to do with the Guiyuan Sect.
Du Tian took Zhang Su all the way to a spacious courtyard.
"Dong dong dong".
Du Tian stepped forward and knocked on the door.
The courtyard door opened, and an outer disciple was happy when he saw it was Du Tianhou.
"Brother Du, which one has Senior Brother Zhang chosen to support?"
Du Tian shook his head and said, "Senior Brother Zhang is not satisfied with the financial aid you have given. Therefore, Senior Brother Zhang came to the funding committee in person to discuss with you."
Immediately, Du Tian stepped aside, revealing Zhang Su behind him.
"Senior Brother Zhang?"
The outer disciple reacted immediately.
This is Zhang Su, who has become famous in the outer sect recently!
"Senior Brother Zhang, you are here, the funding conference will be full of glory, please come in!"
This outer disciple treated Zhang Su with great respect.
Zhang Suze walked directly into the courtyard.
This courtyard is also temporarily rented by the Funding Association, and there are many people inside, basically all outer disciples.
The Guiyuan Sect has regulations that those who are not disciples of the outer sect are not allowed to live in the outer sect.
These outer disciples are not sponsored geniuses, but are merely hired with money every month to maintain the operation of the sponsoring association.
Zhang Su walked into the living room.
"Senior Brother Zhang, wait a moment, the vice president of the funding committee will be here soon."
Zhang Su nodded.
Later, Du Tian whispered in Zhang Su's ear: "The vice president of the funding committee is called Yan Bo, and he is also an outer disciple of the ninth level of Qi and Blood Realm."
Not long after, Yan Bo arrived.
The other party was wearing a white shirt, and he looked quite impressive.
"Junior Brother Zhang."
"Senior Brother Yan."
The two sat down.
Yan Bo asked: "Junior brother Zhang has probably received many grants, right? Are you dissatisfied with something, or what's going on? If you have any needs, please feel free to ask."
"Demand..."
Zhang Su looked at Yan Bo and said calmly: "Zhang does have needs. Your support to Zhang is too low. It is only a fourth-level subsidy."
Yan Bo understood instantly.
He probably guessed it too.
Yan Bo said with a smile: "Junior Brother Zhang, the level of funding is determined by those sponsors. Junior Brother may be very talented, but he is currently overage. Within the sect, it is too difficult for overage disciples to be promoted to the inner sect."
"Perhaps this is the concern of those funders."
"Overage... this is a problem. However, maybe those sponsors don't know Zhang's true talent!"
Yan Bo was slightly startled.
He looked Zhang Su up and down carefully and found that he looked confident.
Could it be that Zhang Su still has any confidence?
At this time, Zhang Su mobilized the qi and blood in his body.
"boom".
Suddenly, a powerful force of energy and blood came out of his body, instantly covering Yan Bo.
"Is this... breaking the limits of the human body?"
Yan Bo is also at the ninth level of Qi and Blood Realm.
